name: Mixture-of-Recursions · MoR
tagline: Decide which tokens continue at each recursion boundary.
description: The MoR adaptation in the historical native four-model experiment. All tokens enter the first recursion; two token routers determine whether each token continues into the second and third recursions.
paperTitle: Mixture-of-Recursions: Learning Dynamic Recursive Depths for Adaptive Token-Level Computation
mechanism: 3 prelude + 9 core blocks × up to 3 recursions + 3 coda
Target survival rates of 1 / 0.64 / 0.32, averaging 17.64 core-block executions
The same threshold routing is used for training and evaluation; exited tokens stop supplying in-loop KV
limitations: Trained under the original native protocol with the historical matrix-cost estimate, rather than the operator-level cost ledger.
